_comment: Illustrated art the site may place on a page: ARCHV-drawn player portraits and ARCHV-designed club badges. Faces are illustrated-only by canon, and every badge here is our own typographic disc, never a club's real crest. Read through scripts/shared/illustrated.mjs (generators) or src/render/illustrated.ts (front page), never by hand-writing a path. TWO ASSET HOMES, both in this repo: public/media/illustrated/ holds the 320px front-page portraits and the badges (sources: fifa.archv/assets/headshots and fifa.archv/match-covers/carousel/assets/badges), and public/heads/ holds the 240px webp head bank the daily desk job commits and already cites in entry.image. Phase 2B banked the head-bank faces here so a card gets a portrait even on the days the desk filed no image field. Nothing new was generated: every player below was already drawn, already committed, and already named on this site.
_identity: Each head-bank entry's identity comes from two in-repo records that agree: the bank index at fifa.archv/player-headshot-bank.md, and the desk's own committed imageAlt for that same file in src/data/*.ts. A face with only one of the two is not listed. Deliberately NOT listed: /heads/ederson.webp, because the desk's Ederson is the Atalanta midfielder and a bare mononym would also match Manchester City's goalkeeper, who is a different Brazilian with a different face. A wrong face is worse than no face, so that one stays on the entries that name it by hand.
